src:
!userdel -r anuj 2>/dev/null; groupdel dbda 2>/dev/null; true
useradd -m -s /bin/bash anuj
groupadd dbda
usermod -aG dbda anuj
id anuj
grep -E '^(anuj|student):' /etc/passwd
grep '^dbda:' /etc/group
touch report.csv; ls -l report.csv
chown anuj:dbda report.csv; ls -l report.csv
ls -l /etc/shadow
out:
$ useradd -m -s /bin/bash anuj
$ groupadd dbda
$ usermod -aG dbda anuj
$ id anuj
uid=30034(anuj) gid=30034(anuj) groups=30034(anuj),30035(dbda)
$ grep -E '^(anuj|student):' /etc/passwd
student:x:30033:30033::/home/student:/bin/bash
anuj:x:30034:30034::/home/anuj:/bin/bash
$ grep '^dbda:' /etc/group
dbda:x:30035:anuj
$ touch report.csv; ls -l report.csv
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root 0 Oct 13 23:36 report.csv
$ chown anuj:dbda report.csv; ls -l report.csv
-rw-r--r-- 1 anuj dbda 0 Oct 13 23:36 report.csv
$ ls -l /etc/shadow
-rw-r----- 1 root shadow 1434 Oct 13 23:36 /etc/shadow
